The skill bundle is designed for collaborative world-building for the 'Our Earth Chronicle' project. All instructions in SKILL.md and metadata in claw.json align with this stated purpose, involving API calls to `api.kaoslibrary.com` and `kaoschronicle.com` for registration, prompt retrieval, and contribution submission.
